q1: SELECT b.name AS bar, COUNT(DISTINCT f.drinker) AS num_drinker, AVG(s.price) AS avg_price, (SELECT f1.drinker FROM frequents AS f1 WHERE f1.bar = b.name ORDER BY f1.times_a_week DESC, f1.drinker ASC LIMIT 1) AS most_reg_drinker FROM bar AS b LEFT JOIN frequents AS f ON b.name = f.bar LEFT JOIN serves AS s ON b.name = s.bar GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY num_drinker DESC, b.name ASC
q2: SELECT b.name, (SELECT SUM(times_a_week) FROM frequents AS f WHERE f.bar = b.name) AS total_num_drinker, (SELECT AVG(price) FROM serves AS s WHERE s.bar = b.name) AS avg_price, (SELECT l.drinker FROM frequents AS l WHERE l.bar = b.name ORDER BY l.times_a_week DESC, l.drinker LIMIT 1) AS most_reg_drinker FROM bar AS b ORDER BY total_num_drinker DESC, b.name
